d: The Drop welcomes VidantaWorld Mexico Open winner Andrew Novak to the show, fresh off his victory over the weekend. Novak addresses his first individual win on the PGA Tour, establishing his place in the 2028 Championship Series, how his putter took over – and how he keeps up with the football scores while he’s out on the course. With 3 events remaining on the fall schedule, we examine the various bubbles in the FedExCup Fall standings and what it means for certain players as they seek status for 2027.
